QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_19

question.text: For NRI demat accounts, change of status from Resident Individual to NRI-Repatriable is:

answer.text: Not allowed as a status/sub-status change to NRI Repatriable

explanation.text: The Logic: A change of status/sub-status from Resident Individual or NRI Non-Repatriable to NRI Repatriable is not permitted. Allowed status changes (such as Resident to/from NRI Non-Repatriable, or NRI Repatriable to Individual) require appropriate documentation. The Trap: 'Allowed with appropriate documentation' is correct for the other allowed status changes, but specifically not for moving to NRI Repatriable from Resident or NRI Non-Repatriable. Note: Direction matters: Resident <-> NRI Non-Repatriable and NRI Repatriable -> Individual are permitted; Resident or NRI Non-Repatriable -> NRI Repatriable is prohibited.
